description: Modélisation 3D de bâtiments et du potentiel photovoltaïque - Isère - 2024-2025 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil départemental de l'Isère (CD 38). CRAIG launched in 2024 a 3D modeling project of buildings across the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region to meet the needs of its members. The Department of Isère has partnered with CRAIG to model a selection of buildings in its territory and assess their photovoltaic potential. Coverage: Conseil départemental de l'Isère (CD 38). The portal shows the English title as "3D modeling of buildings and photovoltaic potential - Isère - 2024-2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil départemental de l'Isère (CD 38). Its keywords include solaire, reseau-energie-divers-electricite, batiments, isere, auvergne-rhone-alpes, bati3d. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
